articles.summary: In this exploration of Fixed Wireless Access in the unlicensed 60 GHz band, Peraso’s Mike Hamilton discusses the technology behind mmWave wireless systems, its strengths and weaknesses, and how it is being successfully deployed today to provide gigabit services.
